disclaimer: Illustrative plates · your LUT applied live
runtimeNote: Plates are Apple Log 2 encoded. The app applies the selected stock LUT to the plate live, so previews track a user LUT, a grade tweak or a gauge change without new assets.

appleLog2.transfer: Apple Log 2 (same curve as Apple Log)
appleLog2.primaries: Apple Wide Gamut (published in the Apple Log 2 Profile)
appleLog2.note: primaries/white are published; the RGB<->XYZ matrix is derived from them (same derivation opencolorio-config-aces uses).

curveRoundTrip.note: encode -> decode of the Apple Log 2 curve; validates the toe/log split

whiteBalancePolicy: RAW as-shot camera white balance; no white-patch / grey-world rebalancing is applied, so scene chroma is not inferred.

source.note: Tungsten signage against a dusk sky

derivation.recipe: RAW -> LibRaw scene-linear sRGB (gamma=(1,1), 16-bit, as-shot white balance, no auto-bright) -> linear-light centre 2:3 crop + Lanczos -> Apple Wide Gamut matrix (derived from the published primaries) -> exact Apple Log 2 curve encode (quadratic toe) -> Log plate
derivation.sceneIlluminantProvenance: assumed for this scene, not measured

whiteBalance.source: RAW as-shot camera white balance (LibRaw use_camera_wb=True)

derivation.crop: centre 1080x1620 (2:3) from the full frame, Lanczos
derivation.plateLabel: Apple Log 2 encoded plate (illustrative; NOT a camera original)

plateStats.roundTripNote: display-space difference between the STORED JPEG and the lossless plate (both through the official neutral LUT); this is the real JPEG round-trip error.
plateStats.displayToneDeltaNote: official neutral LUT applied to the stored plate vs a plain sRGB display render of the same as-shot linear; an informational look difference (exposure isolated), not an error.
